record.field: LAB (staging only). Create an email template for folios or reservations, in Spanish and optionally Galician. The subject takes placeholders like {{ object.partner_name }}; the HTML body takes <t t-out="object.partner_name">guest</t> or <span t-field="object.first_checkin"/> for formatted dates and amounts. Only fields of the folio, its guest, its hotel and its stay are allowed; an error lists them. Two steps: confirm=false validates the placeholders and renders the subject and body with a real folio or reservation of the user's hotels; show it and, only after the user's approval, call again with confirm=true and the token. The template is not linked to any automatic sending.
